description: ONS consolidates daily mean river flows and incremental flows between gauging stations. The dictionary supplies station identifiers from the national water-agency register, names, coordinates, rivers, hydro-energy basins and flow values in cubic metres per second. These observations support hydropower inflow and reservoir-network modelling. Station measurements and incremental estimates have distinct meanings; missingness and station-history changes are not established by the catalogue metadata. Coverage is river-gauging stations in hydro-energy basins in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
